# uzc_templates (Data Source)

Lists UzCloud VM templates (operating system images), optionally filtered by region.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "uzc_templates" "tashkent" {
  region = "tashkent"
}

output "ubuntu_template_slugs" {
  value = [
    for t in data.uzc_templates.tashkent.templates : t.slug
    if t.operating_system == "ubuntu"
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `region` (String) Filter to templates available in this region slug.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `templates` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--templates))

<a id="nestedatt--templates"></a>
### Nested Schema for `templates`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String)
- `image_type` (String)
- `name` (String)
- `operating_system` (String) Operating system slug (e.g. "ubuntu").
- `operating_system_family` (String) e.g. "Linux"; use as `os_family` on uzc_virtual_machine.
- `operating_system_version` (String)
- `password_enabled` (Boolean)
- `slug` (String) Use this as `template` on uzc_virtual_machine.
- `status` (Boolean)
- `template_id` (String)
- `type` (String)
